item.title: Lawrence City Commission approves changes to Jayhawk watershed budget; 9th Street to close through summer
item.description: Lawrence City Commissioners on Tuesday approved a $4.82M increase to the budget and change in construction plans that will lead to a portion of Ninth Street being closed through the summer. Continue reading ...

item.title: Lawrence City Commission general public comment for Dec. 9, 2025
item.description: Here’s the general public comment for the Lawrence City Commission’s Tuesday meeting, as public comment is no longer being broadcast. Continue reading ...

item.title: Douglas County to host discussion on how to support low-income, single-caregiver families
item.description: The Douglas County Economic Mobility Project will soon host a "Community Sensemaking Session" focused on how to support low-income and single-parent/caregiver families in the county. Continue reading ...

item.title: Lawrence Art Guild’s Holiday Art Fair offers a chance to shop local this weekend (Sponsored post)
item.description: Twenty-nine local artists will be selling their work at the Lawrence Art Guild’s Holiday Art Fair this weekend at the Cider Gallery. Continue reading ...

item.title: Kansas tribe fires business leaders for accepting $30 million ICE detention center contract
item.description: The Prairie Band Potawatomi Nation has fired senior leaders of its tribally owned business for accepting a nearly $30 million deal to assist U.S. Immigration and Customs Enforcement. Continue reading ...

item.title: Kansas AG ditches anti-immigration health care lawsuit after change in federal policy
item.description: Kris Kobach announced Wednesday he voluntarily dismissed his federal lawsuit that targeted health care for immigrants across the U.S. But health care for certain immigrants was stripped away months ago. Continue reading ...

item.title: Court document details evidence allegedly found in fatal hit-and-run north of Lawrence
item.description: Investigators found fibers in a truck's broken headlight that appear consistent with the shirt a Lawrence runner was wearing when she was struck and killed by a driver who fled the scene last month, according to law enforcement documents. Continue reading ...

item.title: Lawrence Holiday Farmers Market coming up; SNAP tokens available
item.description: The Lawrence Holiday Farmers Market will return Saturday, and this year, the market is offering anyone in need a hand up through Double Up Protein Bucks. Continue reading ...

item.title: Lawrence’s affordable housing board hopes to consider students, funding and more in forthcoming study
item.description: Lawrence Affordable Housing Advisory Board members today identified topics they hope to see addressed in an upcoming housing study, from the university student rental market to new ways to fund housing initiatives. Continue reading ...

item.title: Community members explore options for North Lawrence at open house
item.description: Community members at a North Lawrence Corridor Study open house Wednesday expressed excitement at investment and infrastructure upgrades but also stressed the importance of protecting the core culture of the neighborhood. Continue reading ...
